messages.content: Begin the interview: ask your first question about the client brief.
I have the client brief. Please load your data on the Configure page and press Load & Continue; we will go through the brief on the Planner page with examples from your data.
Skip the questions, use your best guess

Here is what I understood from the brief:
• Goal: Understand transit durations and temperature compliance by supplier and carrier performance.
• Scope: All products, origins, destinations, and carriers in the dataset, using Road transport.
• Period: The full date range of the loaded data (October 19, 2026, to October 28, 2026).
• Limits: Standard temperature limits for cold chain products will be used where not explicitly defined in the data.
• Output: A detailed report for internal analysis, including a new transit duration column, total time above high temperature by parent supplier, and average segment length by carrier.
• Client KPIs: The client's own KPI definitions to follow

I made 5 assumptions where the brief was silent (listed above the chat; you can edit or remove them).

Reply "yes" to confirm, or tell me what to change.
